content: अञ्ज् €7 <ab>P.</ab> (rarely <ab>Ā.</ab>) (अनक्ति or अङ्क्ते, आनञ्ज, अञ्जिष्यति-अङ्क्ष्यति, अञ्जित्वा-अङ्क्त्वा-अक्त्वा, अञ्जितुम्, अङ्क्तुम्, अक्त) .²1 To anoint, smear with, bedaub. .²2 To make clear, show, represent, characterize; मा नाञ्जी राक्षसीर्मायाः <ls>Bk. 9. 49</ls>. .²3 To go. .²4 To shine, be beautiful. .²5 To honour, celebrate. .²6 To decorate. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To smear with, नाञ्जयन्ती स्वके नेत्रे <ls>Ms. 4. 44</ls>. .²2 To speak or shine. .²3 To cause to go. [<ab>cf.</ab> <lang>Zend.</lang> {%anj%}; <lang>L.</lang> {%unctum, ungo%}.] With .{@-अधि@} to fit out, equip, furnish. .{@-आ@} .²1 to anoint, smear. .²2 to smooth, polish, prepare. .²3 to honour, respect. .{@-नि@} .²1 to smear. .²2 to conceal or hide oneself. .{@-प्रति@} .²1 to smear. .²2 to adorn, decorate. .{@-सम्@} .²1 to smear. .²2 to fit out, equip, harness. .²3 to honour. .²4 to join together, to consume, devour; to adorn, decorate, beautify (mostly <ab>Ved.</ab> in these senses). .²5 to unite, to put together, compose.
